_comment: Real Hisense AC UART frames captured from output.txt and historical analysis. Format: F4 F5 | payload | CS_hi CS_lo | F4 FB. Checksum = sum(bytes from index 2 up to but excluding CS bytes) & 0xFFFF, big-endian (CS_hi first).

frames.name: status_query
frames.description: Standard 21-byte status query (0x66) sent by ESPHome to the AC

frames.name: status_response_temp19
frames.description: 82-byte status response, target 21C, indoor 23C, mode OFF (bit 3 of byte[16]=0x30 not set)

frames.name: status_response_temp20
frames.description: Variant of the previous frame with one byte different

frames.name: truncated_frame_bug
frames.description: Truncated frame observed in the wild - missing trailing bytes including footer. Parser must reject without crashing.

frames.name: headerless_fragment_a
frames.description: First response captured after boot - missing F4 F5 header entirely. Should be discarded by a resync-safe parser without disrupting the next frame.

frames.name: headerless_fragment_b
frames.description: Stray bytes captured between frames - mostly zeros plus footer. Parser must drop without crashing.

mode_encoding._comment: Mode is encoded in payload byte 16: high nibble = mode code, bit 3 (0x08) = power on

swing_values._comment: Swing byte encoding used by send_status (status[32])
